<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has sent me the exact same list of times as before, even though I told her none of them work and asked for a complete list of availabilities for Priya and Marcus. It seems she might have misunderstood my request. I need to be more explicit. I will reiterate that the times she provided do not work and ask again for the *full* list of all 30-minute slots when Priya and Marcus are both free next week. Without that, I cannot find a time that works for all four partners. I will then end my session and wait for her response.Hi Alison. Thanks for the quick reply. It looks like you've sent the same list of times as before. As I mentioned in my last message, I've already checked these specific slots, and unfortunately, none of them work for Elena and David.

To find a time that works for all four partners, could you please send me the *complete* list of all 30-minute slots when Priya and Marcus are both available next week (Mon Nov 16 to Fri Nov 20, 9am to 5pm)? Once I have the full list, I can compare it against Elena's and David's calendars to find a common slot.
